properties.command_line:
%system32%\windowspowershell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -noprofile -noninteractive -executionpolicy unrestricted <decoded_b64: &chcp.com 65001 > $null
$exec_wrapper_str = $input | out-string
$split_parts = $exec_wrapper_str.split(@("0000"), 2, [stringsplitoptions]::removeemptyentries)
if (-not $split_parts.length -eq 2) { throw "invalid payload" }
set-variable -name json_raw -value $split_parts[1]
$exec_wrapper = [scriptblock]::create($split_parts[0])
&$exec_wrapper> <ps_bypass_flag>
properties.name: powershell.exe
